sourceMapping.rule: Retain native glyph occurrences, real replica/metadata, every paper, line, roller, clip and painter order

sourceProof.interval: Lantern body/ribs/caps/verse share source pivot. Persistent hold sway is +/-2.2 single or +/-3 row. Full motion is bounded by +/-8.2 or +/-13 degrees, single top displacement [-.3H,0], and row outBack scale [0,1.2]. Light glow and stage wire/cord are explicitly background decoration, jointly replayed without changing attachment; they are not lyric/paper ink.
sourceProof.stageProof: Per-source pivot/trigonometric/drop/scale intervals enclose every primary owned event. Every blank panel, crest, body, cap, rib and lyric stays classified; camera interval and joint replay preserve clips and connections.

backgroundDecoration.glowReason: Source radial body-colour lighting fading to transparency contains no glyph silhouette or letter shadow; physical body/ribs/caps/verse remain primary. This source-based role is fixed for every radius.
backgroundDecoration.attachment: All decoration uses the same joint replay offset. Single ceiling cord compensates replay dy through the inverse native root affine, preserving its original screen y. Row x offset is constrained to zero; its original 31-point reveal and edge supports remain unchanged.

sourceProof.limitations: Cut/still text motion only; unsupported source domains fail explicitly

scope: Local independent immutable native before/after; no image inspection by implementation agent; no public operation
